info.name: MeshMess API — Phase 1-7
info.description:
Mess Management SaaS backend. Covers Auth, Mess/Boarder/Manager/Handover, Meal, Expense, Payment, the Accounting Engine, and the Shop domain + Shop-to-Mess Integration Bridge (Phase 1-7).

FOUR ENVIRONMENTS (import all): MeshMess-Admin, MeshMess-Manager, MeshMess-Boarder, MeshMess-Shopadmin — each holds its own accessToken/userId. Switch the environment dropdown (top-right) whenever a request says '⚠️ switch to X' or '(as X)'.

Shared resource IDs (messId, expenseId, periodId, shopId, etc.) live in POSTMAN GLOBALS instead of any one environment, so they survive switching roles. Also import MeshMess.postman_globals.json — it populates automatically as you run requests (via each request's Tests script).

PLATFORM ADMIN SETUP (one-time, before folder '14. Vendor & Shop' works): set PLATFORM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAILS=rafi@example.com in apps/api/.env, restart the server, then register Rafi — his account is created with platformRole=PLATFORM_ADMIN automatically.

SUGGESTED ORDER:
1. Auth > Register: run all FOUR Register requests once (any environment).
2. Auth > Login: select each environment in turn and run its matching Login.
3. Mess (as Admin): Create Mess.
4. Boarder: Invite Nabil (as Admin) -> switch to Boarder env -> Accept Invite.
5. Manager: Assign Karim (as Admin) -> switch to Manager env -> Accept Assignment.
6. Meal Config (as Admin) -> Meal > Generate -> Opt Out (as Boarder).
7. Expense Category + Expense (as Admin/Manager).
8. Payment: Record Cash (as Manager) -> Confirm Cash (as Boarder).
9. Accounting: Get Current Period -> Initiate Close -> Close Period (as Admin).
10. Vendor & Shop (as Platform Admin/Shop Admin) -> Product Catalog (as Shop Admin).
11. Shop Order: Create+Place (as Manager) -> Confirm+Process+Deliver (as Shop Admin) -> check Expense list (as Admin) for the auto-created DRAFT_FROM_SHOP entry.
